sections.source: centro.h::Motore::disegnaWidget combined Weather and News surface
sections.adaptation: One existing native Control Center HWND/ticket pins original illustrated forecast above original two-line News/source/status rows. Existing wallpaper weather subscriber/cache and bounded News worker/cache remain sole data owners; independent generation/action validation and source navigation, keyboard paging and native MSAA remain. Delivery releases its own model borrow before rebuilding the combined view; close detaches both owners and refuses late results. Standalone routes are retained. Original expanding inline city search and full Control Center fidelity remain incomplete; hosted actual combined pixel/action/lifetime fixtures pending. No second widget service/cache/request engine or persistent render loop.

Observe same-size foreground top-level HWND movement while left input remains held, for apps without MOVESIZESTART. Only one recent foreground identity/rect/DPI/monitor/time record instead of an all-window map; no timer/worker/hook/input suppression. Reuse existing live GPU Jelly session/mesh/proxy/Guardian preparation/alpha1/release/cancel/recovery, refuse duplicate active native geometry/effect/drag, stale or changed identity/size/DPI/topology. Existing both-role native fixture expanded with actual foreground custom movement/deformation/live repaint/recovery; hosted and physical-app verification pending. Does not implement the separate prepared maximized-detach spring.

Original 56px row, title font13 medium and two fixed17px lines within34px with ellipsis; independent muted timestamp at right. Existing Control Center HWND, 2x bitmap/glass, scoped software widget target/shared factories and News data/feed/cache/actions/keyboard/MSAA/paging owner. Native failure drops canvas and repaints full real glass, clears pressed state and revokes old accessibility action revision. No extra GPU device/feed/worker/window. Source selection stays existing list, not full unified Control Center fidelity. Hosted bitmap/panel/failure/locale tests pending.

sections.source: fluidwin.cpp::suTasto volume route and UI heartbeat; dock.h::cambiaVolume; centro.h::volumeTasto
sections.adaptation: Physical volume Up/Down/Mute through the existing single shared input hook and original standalone OSD. Original 2% rounding, Up-only unmute and mute toggle; 250ms UI heartbeat with one-second refusal. Existing global utilities callback permit serializes all audio work without a new dedicated worker, device or audio session; 64-command bounded FIFO, one-second per-command expiry, current default endpoint and actual readback. Nonblocking hook admission and balanced native/repeated/consumed edges, untouched injected/modified keys. Pre-setter cancellation, no retry/replay after uncertain mutation, native replay only for fresh unattempted commands, endpoint-event rearm and ticket/closed result isolation. Opt-in existing profile/vi-en-zh Settings. TEST refuses native audio and input writes; hosted synthetic tests exercise actual callback and real Windows pool. Physical endpoint and Windows OSD replacement require later verification.

Original two-stop blue gradient, 168-pixel weather-card structure, current temperature, WMO sun/cloud/fog/rain/snow/lightning geometry and five forecast columns. Same scoped native Control Center HWND/input/keyboard/MSAA owner and source data shared with wallpaper; no extra feed/cache/network/window/thread/D3D device. Original factories serve a software DC render target retained only while this view is open. Draw into the existing 2x panel bitmap with DPI/GDI mapping respected; copy actual existing glass pixels into the scoped target to preserve rounded corners. Format/bitmap/target lifetimes are scoped; failure falls back to existing accessible text layout, and small work areas keep the list. Current/city and individual forecast accessibility bounds reflect their real locations; refresh/units/city/settings actions keep generation validation. Existing complete forecast remains available after the five illustrated days. City picker stays the existing native picker, not the original expanding inline search. New native pixel/glyph/corner tests at 96/144/192 DPI and real vi/en/zh panel images are pending hosted CI.

Retain the actual failing activation-factory, exact-interface, get_Current and GetAccessStatus HRESULT/operation/access status through cleanup. Distinguish a successful Denied/Unspecified result from API failure and actual APPMODEL_ERROR_NO_PACKAGE. No RequestAccessAsync call, capability/identity bypass, permission prompt or content logging. Hosted history fixture exports only numeric diagnosis; production UI localizes the relevant access reason. This diagnoses the existing reader and does not implement banners/badges or establish the owner's access status. Official listener requirements: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/develop/notifications/app-notifications/notification-listener .

Original active-render endpoint identity, Bluetooth PnP container matching/BTH prefixes, friendly-name extraction and optional Windows battery property. Original Notch glyph from blob b44082a6634d16983c45d873d7d8db025c90627c (CRLF SHA-256 c519f89e6f7f5a99aeaee5c2da7f30ddca9e85b0cce5d8792354a38873d1597a) is hosted in existing independent OSD, never constructing Notch. MMDevice notification-only enumerator on existing Dock COM apartment replaces polling. Callbacks coalesce and post only, with no waits, enumeration, audio writes, callback unregister or UI rendering. One transient Windows-pool callback reads at most 64 endpoint identities and one read-only 5000-node PnP snapshot; no retained audio endpoint or dedicated thread. Unknown/read failures reset silent baseline; initial/resume reading never announces existing devices. Same-container new endpoints coalesce to one notice. Unique source tickets, cancelled shared state and one global admission permit prevent stale/overlapping workers. Disable/suspend/exit unregister; an unregister failure retains at most one disabled callback object and blocks replacement. Existing native glass/owner speed/reduced motion/monitor/fullscreen policy, vi/en/zh labels and no-focus/input are reused. Physical Bluetooth hotplug/property availability and owner rendering remain unverified. Core Audio lifetime follows https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/mmdeviceapi/nn-mmdeviceapi-immnotificationclient and unregister documentation.

Original first-reading suppression, AC change, 20/10 percent thresholds and recharge rearm. Battery glyph source notch.h blob b44082a6634d16983c45d873d7d8db025c90627c, original CRLF SHA-256 c519f89e6f7f5a99aeaee5c2da7f30ddca9e85b0cce5d8792354a38873d1597a. Windows AC/battery percentage subscriptions replace original 2-second polling; fresh GetSystemPowerStatus query ignores payload and never changes power policy. Unknown/absent state resets baseline. Scoped on Dock enabled/unlocked, unregister on disable/suspend/exit; no worker/cache/render loop. Existing shared original OSD hosts localized 2.5-second standalone battery notice with original Notch battery geometry, adaptive glass ink, owner speed/reduced motion, full-screen suppression and no focus/input. Dynamic Notch itself is never constructed. Physical battery events and headphones remain separate unverified/incomplete routes.

Static photos on existing Stage worker: whole-frame uncovered screen first, otherwise original bounded stampa callback, native-resolution opaque BGRA upload on shared ShellGpu. Only verified rectangular/non-layered sources fully on connected monitors; shaped/rounded/layered/off-display sources keep alpha-aware WGC, live Jelly always keeps WGC. Identity/visibility/affinity/geometry/style checks before/after, conservative full-area occlusion and connected-monitor checks, dynamic GPU and available-RAM refusal without downsample. Global print permit survives caller timeout until callback finishes. No artificial frame recoloring, border masking, foreign-state write or second renderer. Original blank PrintWindow heuristic retained; a verified screen black source is valid. Physical app compatibility and owner border cause/acceptance remain unverified.

After the existing prepared geometry reaches its native target, wait for exact Guardian restoration, then fade the old layout's same click-through proxy using original 150ms smoothstep through existing owner speed/frame clock. The restored real HWND supplies the updated layout underneath; no duplicate capture/device or foreign policy. This is the final native-content handoff only: original timed PrintWindow reread/signature stabilization and pre-command titlebar input remain incomplete.

Read-only WASAPI active capture sessions and Windows webcam ConsentStore reports on explicit Control Center open/refresh. Scoped COM/process/registry handles instead of retained sensor singleton/main poll loop. Maximum 32 endpoints, 256 sessions per endpoint, 500 registry rows per root, 16 bounded basename labels per source; unknown/partial reports remain explicit. No recording, camera activation, privacy write, process launch or full-path export. Closed/ticket delivery and globally single scoped pool callback; no persistent data. Battery/headphone notices and standalone OSD remain separate incomplete routes.

All 29 original settings destinations and keywords; TLauncher own Settings replaces the FluidWin marker, control/taskmgr reuse existing canonical .exe identities. vi/en/zh labels and keywords, English/Italian original terms retained, Vietnamese accent folding. Existing Compact and Fullscreen search/result/keyboard owners and System category, exact target allowlist and ordinary Windows Shell launch. No new catalog, index, thread, poll timer, network or executable discovery. Ephemeral settings results preserve app/library pins and recents; canonical selection survives later indexed-file arrivals. Gear glyph uses existing text rendering without new per-URI icon work. Actual Windows page reachability/owner interaction remains separate from synthetic hosted tests.

Original rounded/small/square factors and DWM preference table, shared by existing TLauncher own-UI appearance profile and native Rust raster/mask/region/shadow owners; original C++ glass/menu uses raggio directly. Imported menu joins original marked-HWND registration so stale handles are rejected. Rust DWM changes additionally require current-process identity; no foreign application attributes are changed. Existing TLauncher base radii/default design are retained; no Windhawk installation/patching or system policy writer. Geometry caches reject previous styles; Start and compact Spotlight refresh on the owning main thread; native controls/profile/vi-en-zh Settings are preserved. Whole original Settings replacement remains separate.

sections.adaptation: Original current/five-day Open-Meteo query fields, WMO description groups, Celsius/km/h internal values, Windows unit selection and forecast-location date labels. Structured serde_json parsing replaces substring numeric parsing; temperature/humidity/cloud/rain/snow/forecast share one request/cache with the pre-existing wallpaper weather owner. Generation validation rejects an earlier city's late result; scoped HTTPS transport has time/body bounds and single active Windows pool callback. Native Control Center view, refresh and unit choice reuse existing config/location settings; native EDIT/LISTBOX city selection reuses the existing profile with 60 UTF-16 units, six results, 300ms debounce and immediate generation-checked invalidation. Shared bounded geocoding transport also replaces the old unbounded Settings request. Rich illustrated/inline-card fidelity remains incomplete. No FluidWin registry/weather singleton is started.

Original four directional two-pixel display edges and greater-than-200ms uninterrupted dwell without held mouse buttons; fold-transfer-reveal in the existing Dock spring/surface owner and existing speed/reduced-motion policy. Reuses one Dock HWND and icon owner, closes transient surfaces, recomputes destination DPI/work-area/profile geometry and migrates cooperative reservations; no second Dock, input hook or worker. An 80ms UI timer exists only for enabled follow mode with multiple connected outputs; refuses foreign-motion/input/fullscreen-target conflicts. Existing config stores the last display ID and preserves independent Stage placement; synthetic injected-topology hosted evidence remains separate from physical mixed-DPI interaction.

Original nonactivating SetWindowPos topmost behavior, explicit marker-before-mutation and synchronous foreign enable on existing pool. Existing single detached Guardian, process-birth identity, pending-begin acknowledgement, distinct lease kind/key, exact-bit restoration and startup orphan recovery. Refuses pre-existing topmost, elevated, Shell, owned targets and owner groups with pre-existing topmost popups. Adds native Dock/Control Center routes and opt-in Ctrl+Win+T with vi/en/zh Settings; no global policy, permanent worker or reassertion against another app.

Reference-only unlocked-session shelf in existing native Control Center, not Dynamic Notch. Original CF_HDROP/HDROP handling, case-insensitive deduplication, atomic maximum-200 admission, Shell IDataObject and copy/move/link completion. Physical drag starts after Windows thresholds; keyboard can copy Shell references. Six visible Shell thumbnails/icons, centered filenames and fixed all/clear controls follow miniatura/rettOggetto/scaffaleScena; responsive rows and paging retain access to all 200 references rather than hiding overflow. Shared existing glass/text/pixel/icon-alpha renderer, one globally admitted scoped pool callback instead of synchronous UI extraction; page/ticket/closed delivery, bounded 120px images and four-second admission timer. OLE/drop registration and session cleanup remain scoped; shelf stays open while Explorer has focus. Original illustration/exact style and actual owner drag fidelity remain unverified.

Retain Shell item/context binding and canonical Uninstall verb discovery; scoped COM/menu/subclass lifetime; native Windows menu on Spotlight thread to preserve Dock-only ownership of imported single-threaded D2D factory; existing TLauncher organization and pin actions remain. No direct uninstall command parsing.

Same normal WinRT radio and DDC/CI APIs, on existing transient utility worker; typed scoped activation factories, consent and result checks, per-device stale-state checks, monitor identity captured at gesture, actual native readback, physical-handle RAII and no optimistic success. Original permanent Sistema worker is not started.

Hexadecimal SSID in a temporary manual open-network XML profile; revalidate clicked interface and refuse a saved or newly secured network; preserve existing known-profile path and Windows credential UI; TEST builds remain read-only.
